ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the medial regions with high-intensity (white) pixels localized on distal lobes; estimated 70:30 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal fluke regions consist of a contiguous dark-pixel blob. The left distal lobe features a white geometric patch interrupted by a vertical dark-pixel line. The right distal lobe contains an extensive white patch with fine-grained dark-pixel mottling and streaks radiating toward the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center, approximately 45 degrees, with a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular sawtooth serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks is higher on the distal segments of both lobes compared to the medial segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a convex leading edge trajectory and a tapered, slightly concave sweep approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-10 pixels diameter) observed; approximately 5 clusters on the dark central region and 4-6 along the leading edge of the left lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical dark-pixel linear feature on the left white lobe; several faint horizontal streaks across the central black region; a short diagonal white linear mark on the right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical black scar/pigment mark bisecting the white region of the left lobe; irregular jagged erosion on the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine dendritic-style black pixel striations within the high-intensity white patch of the right lobe.
